Rina (PM): quick call 2: need to lock the 7/15 cutlist. Two items contentious: multi-tenant embeddings cache vs. prompt-templating UX. ACME wants embeds. options: pilot-dedicated cache, ship non-cached global, or keep templating and defer embeds. Thoughts?
Marco (Eng): infra reality: cache requires KV shard change that risks OOMs under burst. pilot-dedicated pool is ~5 dev days + infra; non-cached path is ~2 dev days.
Aya (ML): cached path = +8% recall and better tail latency. non-cached is acceptable for onboarding but not for ACME at scale.
Jon (Design): templating helps onboarding, but we can ship with improved examples quickly (~1-2 days).
Priya (CS): ACME will accept an invite-only pilot if we give quotas and a rollback plan. They prefer GA cache but can pilot.
Rina (PM): proposal: pilot-dedicated cache for invited customers + ship non-cached for GA. Keep templating deprioritized but add compact prompts. This preserves ship date and keeps ACME. quick vote?
Marco (Eng): +1 to proposal. Need feature flag + quota + infra ticket.
Aya (ML): +1. I'll add eval probes and recall dashboard for pilot.
Jon (Design): +1. I'll deliver compact prompt kit and pilot UI copy.
Priya (CS): +1 with condition: SLA guardrails documented before onboarding.
Rina (PM): consensus = pilot-dedicated cache + GA non-cached + templating deprioritized. Actions: @Marco open INFRA-4012 for pilot pool, implement flag; @Aya add eval job; @Jon draft comms; @Priya prep onboarding checklist.
deploy-bot: created feature-flag rollout/embeds-pilot-dedicated (staged=false)
Marco (Eng): opened INFRA-4012 and PR for flag (WIP).
Rina (PM): I'll update the release tracker: "MVP: GA uses non-cached embeddings with strict quotas; provide invite-only dedicated cache pilot for select customers; defer multi-tenant cache to v1; deprioritize prompt-templating to post-MVP." Keep updates here.
